firmware.note: CircuitPython on the board, fox-bench's foxlib and a BLE template (ble-beacon, puzzle-beacon) deployed over the REPL; the SoC's own radio, no module and no Wi-Fi. The board variant sets the CircuitPython build and the LED / battery pins; a connected board's reported id picks it (the XIAO nRF52840 and its Sense twin share one build and report Seeed_XIAO_nRF52840_Sense). CircuitPython is installed by hand: a .uf2 onto the XIAO-SENSE drive, or bossac for the Nano 33 BLE. On the bench 2026-11-24 (XIAO): both BLE templates from .mpy. The nRF52's watchdog cannot be stopped once it runs, so a soft reboot leaves the previous run's watchdog counting: foxlib adopts and feeds it, and a board left idle at the REPL for longer than limits.watchdog_s resets into safe mode (safemode.py restarts the fox; a power cycle clears it).
